field_checks.summary: Primary XML/PDF Table 1 was independently compared against the final activity rows: 24 MIC/MBC rows and 8 MBIC rows match source values/units/targets, including the preserved P. aeruginosa BotrAMP14 prose/table conflict. Body/figure evidence adds 2 time-kill and 4 in vivo bacterial-load rows with exact-vs-approximate status.

All 42 database/fallback candidate rows were reviewed. The current primary paper names the four peptides but does not print plain one-letter sequences; final database records correctly keep candidate_sequence and candidate_sequence_length null, classify all 42 as unresolved_record, and keep authoritative ingest false. No object containing both a plain one-letter sequence and sequence_length was found in current final mirrors.

The paper and packet final mirrors are byte-identical and final counts agree for activity_records=38, toxicity_records=33, database_record_audits=42, and mechanism_claims=3. However, both final materials_manifest mirrors are stale relative to live packet state: they still report analysis_queue_status=analysis_needs_analysis_rework and three open_rework_ticket_ids, while packet_manifest, analysis_status, review_report, live rework closure evidence, and the latest acceptance audit report zero open tickets and analysis_source_reviewed_accepted.

Mechanism ontology preserves evidence strength: 0 direct_mechanism claims, 1 phenotype_supported claim, and 2 inferred_mechanism claims. Prior-literature SEM/membrane language remains inferred/reference context and is not promoted to current-paper direct mechanism evidence.

Paper identity is traceable to PMC12837634, DOI 10.3390/antibiotics15010077, PMID 41594114, title, journal, and year. Entity linkage covers Btn (15-34), BotrAMP14, Ctn (15-34), and CrotAMP14. Caution remains because authoritative linked APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP rows are absent and source sequence identity is not source-verified in this primary paper.

Activity, toxicity, database, and mechanism outputs carry source locators and preserve direct versus approximate measurements, including approximate Figure 3B and Supplementary Figure S1 digitization. Caution is retained because the current final materials_manifest status/ticket fields are stale even though locator_count=170 and source surfaces are present.

Recursive authority boundary is false: fallback DBAASP/Codex machine rows are candidate evidence only, source_verified_count is 0, authoritative_ingest_ready and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready are false, and review_report preserves machine_fallback_rows_not_promoted=true. Fallback rows remain excluded from authoritative/portal-style ingest.

Source conflicts are preserved rather than smoothed: Table 1 gives P. aeruginosa BotrAMP14 MIC/MBC 0.78 µM while prose says below 0.78 µM, Figures 1-2 captions use ATCC 003321216 while body/other in vivo text uses 00332121, and authoritative database rows are absent. These are cautions, not hidden blockers.

The staged supplement was independently inspected: source zip contains one supplementary PDF, which is packet-promoted with text, PNG render, S1 figure records, and no missing/unparsed material. The blocker is not source absence; it is that both current final materials_manifest mirrors still carry nonterminal ticket/status fields after live closure, so the final material record is not publication-grade current.

Toxicity/selectivity coverage is source-complete for current materials: Table 1 hemolytic activity and Raw 264.7 IC50 rows are present, BotrAMP14 approximate hemolysis IC50 92 uM from text is accepted with approximate status and table/S1 support, and 24 Supplementary Figure S1 percent-hemolysis points are represented as approximate plotted values.

blocking_findings.reason: Both current final materials_manifest mirrors are stale relative to the live packet/ticket state. They still report analysis_queue_status=analysis_needs_analysis_rework, list three open_rework_ticket_ids, and state that fresh worker-6 adjudication is required before terminal ticket closure. In contrast, packet_manifest.json and analysis_status.json report analysis_source_reviewed_accepted with no open tickets; rework_responses.jsonl and closure_receipts.jsonl close the tickets; review_report.json and the latest strict acceptance audit report open_rework_ticket_count=0. Because materials_manifest.json is one of the current final JSON records, this violates the requirement that mechanical/runtime/ticket evidence be current before publication-grade PASS.
required_actions: Regenerate both paper and packet final materials_manifest.json mirrors from the current packet state after ticket closure, setting analysis_queue_status to analysis_source_reviewed_accepted and open_rework_ticket_ids to an empty list.

Remove or rewrite nonterminal strict_boundary/current-status language that says worker-6 adjudication or ticket closure is still pending, while preserving the 170 locator count, 38 supplementary locator/text rows, promoted S1 surfaces, and zero missing-material state.
Recompute mirror/ticket evidence after the material manifest rewrite and ensure the final review report, packet_manifest, analysis_status, and materials_manifest all agree on live open ticket state.
acceptance_checks: Both final materials_manifest.json mirrors have open_rework_ticket_ids == [] and analysis_queue_status == analysis_source_reviewed_accepted, and their SHA256 hashes are identical.
Final review_report.open_rework_ticket_count equals the live packet analysis_status.open_rework_ticket_count and the live rework ticket closure computation.

cautions.summary: P. aeruginosa BotrAMP14 has a preserved prose/table concentration conflict, A. baumannii strain labels differ across body text and figure captions, and no authoritative database rows are linked. These are retained as cautions and do not justify authoritative ingest.

The actual review_report paper/packet mirrors are byte-identical, but the embedded mirror_hash_report values for review_report itself do not equal the current file SHA256; non-self artifact hashes match. This should be cleaned up during the required materials-manifest repair.
